summary: Add guarded recipe sharing link request, acceptance, cancellation, unlink, listing, and source-link commands.
reason: Public AnyList client evidence confirms multipart link_request protobuf requests for request/cancel, scalar multipart fields for accept/unlink, and fresh PBRecipeDataResponse user data for linked-user verification. The CLI keeps every write preview-only until explicit --apply, resolves destructive targets by exact IDs or unambiguous emails, validates target emails, and verifies pending/linked state after each live write. recipes link is a local read-only source-URL lookup; no email or print operation is invented.
validated_outcome: Focused client tests prove exact multipart routes, field names, binary link_request parts, scalar accept/unlink fields, response types, and identifier validation. CLI tests prove email validation, exact/ambiguous target resolution, offline write previews, command registration, and selector safety. No live invite, accept, cancel, or unlink writes were performed.
